title: Iconography: one icon set, consistent construction, semantic aliases
description: The application uses a single icon set with consistent stroke width and grid size across every icon. Icons are referenced through semantic aliases (for example icon.danger, icon.close) rather than per-component bespoke artwork. Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology; meaningful icons carry accessible names.
rationale: Mixed icon sets read as unfinished even when every individual icon is fine. One set, aliased semantically, keeps replacement and theming mechanical.
